reference: 来湖州旅游不但能欣赏到绿水青山
english: Visiting Huzhou, you can not only enjoy clear rivers and green mountains
expected_finetuned: 到湖州旅游不但能欣赏到绿水青山
finetuned_note: Small slip: 来 ("come to") became 到 ("go to"). The meaning is unchanged.
baseline: 到5G的利益,不得能给新商家了水清洗

reference: 记者来到湖州市机动车驾驶考试服务中心
english: A reporter visited the Huzhou Motor Vehicle Driving Test Center
expected_finetuned: 记者来到湖州市机动车驾驶考试服务中心
baseline: 這裡到5G日期中處加斯科斯佛重型

reference: 这位老人叫席中科今年94岁了
english: This elderly man is named Xi Zhongke, and he is 94 years old this year
expected_finetuned: 这位老人叫薛中科今年94岁
finetuned_note: Misheard the surname 席 (Xi) as 薛 (Xue) and dropped the final particle 了.
baseline: 这个老人家叫中科,跟你讲就是手术
baseline_note: Starts roughly right ("this old man is called Zhongke"), then turns into gibberish ("let me tell you, it's surgery").

reference: 青塘小区是一个高度老龄化的老小区
english: Qingtang is an old neighborhood with a large elderly population
expected_finetuned: 青塘小区是一个高度老龄化的老小区
baseline: 青銅小池是一個高的龍領湖的龍小池

reference: 喜欢游古镇的乌镇西塘离湖州都很近
english: For people who like ancient water towns, Wuzhen and Xitang are both close to Huzhou
expected_finetuned: 喜欢游古镇的那么湖州西塘离湖州都很近
finetuned_note: Misheard the town name 乌镇 (Wuzhen) as 那么湖州 ("so, Huzhou").
baseline: 只会与狗子一样,干嘛无争其达,利用群里,是没经验

reference: 几个领导在你办公室等着视察呢
english: A few leaders are waiting in your office for an inspection.
expected_finetuned: 几个领导在你办公室等着视察呢
baseline: 是个令狼,有了那片空心,等着死餐呢

english: They may not be able to wait half a year.
expected_finetuned: 他们不一定等得了半年
finetuned_note: Same meaning in different words: 未必 and 不一定 both mean "not necessarily". The error rate still counts every changed character.
baseline_note: Unrelated to what was said: it means "add starch".

reference: 财主家里有个叫狗四的管家是个坏家伙
english: The landlord had a steward called Gou Si, a nasty piece of work.
expected_finetuned: 才子家里有个叫狗四弟管家是个外家伙
finetuned_note: Sound-alike mistakes: 财主 (landlord) became 才子 (scholar) and 坏 (bad) became 外 (outside); the sentence structure is right.
baseline: 这次家里有个叫高石的国家是个娃家
baseline_note: Gets the sentence frame ("…had someone called … who was a …") but garbles the names and key words.
